key_insight: BrReMark adds explicit region marking and re-checking to brain MRI diagnosis, helping the model ground findings in visible evidence instead of single-pass guesses.
clinical_relevance: This could make MRI AI outputs more auditable and less prone to hallucinated abnormalities, which is important for trustworthy clinical use.
method: Generate a hypothesis about possible abnormalities.
Mark suspected regions with bounding boxes, then verify the conclusion by re-examining the marked evidence.
Train with structured reasoning fine-tuning plus reinforcement learning, and add synthetic pathology augmentation for OOD robustness.
evidence_signal: On the internal benchmark, BrReMark raised mAP50 from 0.74% to 37.54% and reached 21.57% Clinical F1 and 45.26% diagnostic accuracy; on NOVA OOD, it reduced false positives by 45.7% versus the state of the art.
watch_item: The approach depends on reliable box localization and synthesis quality, so performance may vary when pathology appearance or annotation standards differ across sites.
paper_title: Enhancing Brain MRI Anomaly Detection and Reasoning with ROI Rethink and Synthetic Data
